sents.t: In March, Rosa finally taught me her famous lasagna recipe.
Her grandmother brought it from Italy many years ago.
“How much cheese do we have?” Rosa asked.
“Not much. There’s only a little mozzarella,” I said.
“We don’t have any tomatoes.” So we went to the store and bought a lot of things: two pounds of ground beef, onions, garlic, three cans of tomatoes, noodles, and plenty of cheese.
I chopped the onions and cried like a baby.
Rosa cooked the meat with the onions, garlic, tomatoes, salt, and a little sugar.
“The sauce has to cook slowly for an hour.”
Then we made layers: sauce, noodles, cheese, and again: sauce, noodles, cheese.
We baked it for forty-five minutes.
Even Max was waiting at the kitchen door!
“Now it’s your recipe too,” Rosa said.

comp.fa: دستور پخت رزا از کجا آمده است؟

comp.q: How much cheese did they have?

comp.q: Who was waiting at the kitchen door?
comp.fa: چه کسی دمِ در آشپزخانه منتظر بود؟
